title: [CON2-3] No rule makes anyone update the DM admission host's member list when a member, logger or r
description: Review finding CON2-3: No rule makes anyone update the DM admission host's member list when a member, logger or recorder is added (lens CON2). Location: spec/04-access-control.md:158, :259; spec/07-compliance.md:210-216, :336-352; spec/06-calls.md:466. Fix: §4.6 is permissive ("any listed member replaces it after a membership change"); the only obligations are on create ("The initiator registers the list") and on leave (§4.8 line 259). §7.8.2 steps 1-5 and the §7.8 Conformance Summary never mention `DMMembers`. A new member not put on the list cannot authenticate to the host, and a regulated member in request state (§7.8.7) cannot sign a `DMMembers` replacement unless already listed. Apply the reviewer's fix: "The committer of every Commit that adds or removes a member MUST replace the member list by `DMMembers` before delivering the Welcome"; add the step to §7.8.2 after step 4 and to §6.12.7; add a Conformance Summary row (Committing client, MUST). The recorder clause is a clarity gain only: §6.12.7 already says `complianceLoggers` "records both text logger DIDs and VTC recorder DIDs", but §4.6 should say "compliance loggers and recorders" explicitly. Full text: notes/review2/CON2-verified.md and notes/review2/CON2.md.
